-- No WF premise or restrictions on the initial register vector.
example (p : Program) (R : Registers) (N : Nat) (c : Configuration)
    (e : Edge) (d : Nat) (hr : run p N ⟨[], R⟩ = some c)
    (hw : walk p (p.nnodes + 1) p.root c.path 0 = some (e, d)) :
    ∀ b ∈ c.path.drop d, b = false := no_stray p R N c e d hr hw

-- Explicit consumed depth strictly exceeds the stored path length.
example : ([true] : List Bool) ++ List.replicate 3 false =
    consume [true] 3 ++ List.replicate 1 false := by
  exact gap_consume [true] 3 3 (by decide) (by intro b hb; simp at hb)

-- A reachable clean path supplies the actual whole-tape symbolic input.
example (p : Program) (R0 : Registers) (N : Nat) (logical : Configuration)
    (e : Edge) (d gap : Nat) (spares : List Nat) (binary : Config 252)
    (hr : run p N ⟨[], R0⟩ = some logical)
    (hw : walk p (p.nnodes + 1) p.root logical.path 0 = some (e, d))
    (hd : d ≤ 40)
    (hf : DispatchFrame SitePerm252.dispatch binary logical gap spares) :
    Represents (logical.path.length + gap - 40) (vregs logical.registers ++ spares)
      (SitePerm252.start (consume logical.path d)) binary := by
  apply source_represents logical binary gap spares (consume logical.path d) hf
  · rw [consume_length]
  · simpa only [consume_length] using no_stray p R0 N logical e d hr hw
  · simpa only [consume_length] using hd

-- The nonzero physical spare is not identified with the zero logical tail.
example (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) :
    boxBits (.plain (.decrement (SitePerm252.physical r hr))) (vregs R ++ spares) =
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits
        (vregs (update R r (R r - 1)) ++ (spares ++ [0])) ++ [false] :=
  decrement_rebase R spares r hr

-- A named zero guard reads the permuted primary block for the logical register.
example (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) (hz : R r = 0) :
    Valid (some (SitePerm252.physical r hr, true)) (vregs R ++ spares) :=
  valid_branch R spares r hr true hz

-- Overflow means one extra marker/header cell; the target frame is complete.
example (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (P : List Bool) (x : Box) (R : Registers)
    (spares : List Nat) (binary : Config 252) (hl : P.length ≤ 41)
    (ht : LogicalTailZero R)
    (hb : boxBits x vs = Permutation252Frame.registerBits (vregs R ++ spares) ++ [false])
    (hs : Represents n vs (SitePerm252.target P true x) binary) :
    DispatchFrame SitePerm252.dispatch binary ⟨P, R⟩ (n + (41 - P.length)) spares :=
  target_frame n vs P true x R spares binary hl ht hb hs

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC

proof_resources.generic_no_stray: All RegisterPath.Program values and all initial Nat→Nat register vectors; no well-formedness premise. A successful next walk is required; walk existence is not asserted.
proof_resources.gap_normalization: Exact list equality under depth≤storedPath.length+gap and all stored suffix bits false. Depth may exceed storedPath.length; consume genuinely zero-extends.
proof_resources.source_adapter: Actual DispatchFrame, exact consumed prefix, clean suffix, depth≤40. Uses arbitrary finite exterior padding and full physical spare suffix.
proof_resources.target_adapter: Actual symbolic Represents, exact complete box-file equality, path length bound, LogicalTailZero for updated registers. Positive decrement rebases to old spares++[0].
